產能端更棘手。A20 Pro 晶圓良率穩定、台積電產線正常，但專用 DRAM 供貨缺口巨大，已產出晶片無法完成 WMCM 整合封裝，台積電超 10 億美元等級的蘋果處理器產能被迫空轉。
供應鏈預判，iPhone 18 首發初期能保基礎鋪貨，但線上等待期拉長、線下門市現貨快速見底。
雪上加霜的是產品線收縮：今秋取消標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone Air 2(延至 2027 初)，僅留 iPhone Ultra 與 18 Pro 系列，入門款需求全數灌向 Pro，供需矛盾被進一步放大。
對消費者而言，新一代 Pro 不是「買不買得起」的單選，而是「付 1399 美元還要等多久」的雙重考驗。
對蘋果來說，DRAM 漲價潮正把硬體定價權從品牌溢價，部分交還給記憶體廠。
paras_en: A few weeks before the release of the iPhone 18 series, Apple's new machine is facing a double whammy of 'cost explosion + DRAM shortage', with a price hike almost certain and initial shortages unavoidable.

According to a report by US tech media 9to5mac, citing supply chain and institutional estimates, the price hike is driven by three hardware costs. Firstly, the global shortage of DRAM and NAND flash memory has led to a sharp increase in memory prices. Secondly, the new variable aperture main camera costs 50% more than the previous generation. Thirdly, the use of TSMC's 2-nanometer A20 Pro chip with WMCM packaging has significantly increased the cost of the advanced process.

According to Wall Street estimates, to maintain a basic profit margin, the new machine's minimum price would need to be $1,299. If image premium is factored in, Apple is likely to set the Pro starting price at $1,399, a $300 increase from the previous generation, with Pro Max following suit.

A previous report by Bloomberg Information also estimated that the Pro price hike would be between $100 and $200. However, Morgan Stanley believes that component optimization could help offset some of the pressure. At $1,299, the machine's profit margin would drop from 47% to 44%, supporting a $1,399 price point.

The production end is even more complicated. The A20 Pro chip has a stable yield rate, and TSMC's production lines are normal, but the shortage of specialized DRAM is massive. The produced chips cannot be completed with WMCM integration packaging, and TSMC's Apple processor production capacity has been forced to idle, with losses exceeding $1 billion.

Supply chain predictions indicate that the initial shipment of iPhone 18 will be able to meet basic demand, but online waiting periods will be extended, and offline store inventory will quickly dwindle.

Adding to the woes is the product line contraction: the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 (delayed to early 2027) will be canceled, leaving only the iPhone Ultra and 18 Pro series. The entry-level demand will be fully shifted to Pro, further exacerbating the supply-demand contradiction.
For consumers, the new Pro series is not a 'can't afford it' option, but a 'can I afford it and wait for how long' double test.
For Apple, the DRAM price surge is taking away the company's hardware pricing power, partly returning it to memory manufacturers.

items.title: AI資料中心需求升溫，Microchip財測優於預期，盤後股價漲7%
items.title_en: AI Data Center Demand Heats Up, Microchip Forecast Beats Expectations, After-Hours Stock Rises 7%
paras: 2026年08月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Microchip Technology(MCHP-US)公布2027會計年度第一季財報，受惠於AI資料中心、工業、汽車及航太市場需求回升，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，並發布優於華爾街預估的第二季財測，激勵盤後股價上漲7%。
公司預估2027會計年度第二季營收將落在15.9億至16.2億美元，高於彙整分析師預估的15.5億美元；調整後每股盈餘預估為0.91至0.95美元，也優於市場預估的0.79美元。
Microchip表示，AI資料中心對晶片需求持續增溫，加上工業與汽車市場景氣循環回升，以及地緣政治因素帶動航太與國防支出成長，共同支撐業績表現。
2027會計年度第一季營收為14.9億美元，高於市場預估的14.6億美元；調整後每股盈餘為0.76美元，也優於市場預估的0.69美元。
同業安森美Onsemi(ON-US)本周稍早也發布優於預期的第三季財測，指出AI資料中心帶動電源管理晶片需求持續成長，顯示AI基礎建設投資仍是類比與電源半導體市場的重要成長動能。

paras_en: August 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Microchip Technology (MCHP-US) released its fiscal 2027 first‑quarter results. Benefiting from a rebound in AI data‑center, industrial, automotive and aerospace demand, both revenue and profit topped market expectations, and the company issued a second‑quarter outlook that beat Wall Street forecasts, lifting the after‑hours share price by 7%.

Peer Onsemi (ON-US) also released an above‑expectations third‑quarter outlook earlier this week, noting that AI data centers continue to boost demand for power‑management chips, indicating that AI infrastructure investment remains a key growth driver for the analog and power semiconductor markets.

items.title: 輝達終結連五紅 財報將成下一個催化劑
items.title_en: Nvidia Ends Five-Day Rally, Earnings Report to Be Next Catalyst
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 周四 (6 日) 一度延續漲勢，但最終未能守住盤中漲幅。市場認為，其將於本月稍晚公布的財報，可能成為推動股價進一步走高的關鍵催化劑。
輝達終場下跌 0.1%，收在 218.99 美元，終結連續五個交易日上漲。當天一度漲至 223.63 美元，隨後回吐全部漲幅。
輝達也是周四標普 500 指數成交量最大個股，以及那斯達克 100 指數成交量第二大股票。
今年以來，輝達股價已上漲 17.3%，過去 12 個月累計漲幅達 21%。
市場可能持續看好輝達在 AI 晶片市場的主導地位。最新跡象之一就是馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 日前透露，SpaceX(SPACEX-US)未來將全面採用輝達的硬體產品。
除此之外，輝達在所謂的主權 AI(Sovereign AI) 領域也占壓倒性優勢。據 Counterpoint Research 周三公布數據，92% 的主權 AI 模型都是使用輝達晶片完成訓練。
輝達 2026 會計年度來自主權 AI 的營收已較去年同期成長逾三倍，突破 300 億美元，公司也寄望未來持續擴大這項業務。
Counterpoint Research 研究總監 Marc Einstein 表示，「隨著主權 AI 基礎設施持續擴張，輝達正於全球各地簽署多項數十億美元規模的合作案，希望掌握下一波 AI 浪潮，也就是 AI 推論以及建設主權 AI 工廠。」
市場下一個重要催化劑，預料將是 8 月 26 日公布的輝達財報。公司股價通常會在財報公布前表現強勢，但財報發布後往往回落，因此市場將觀察這次是否能打破這項走勢。
Susquehanna 分析師 Christopher Jacobson 在研究報告中寫道，「由於輝達股價自上次財報公布後仍處於下跌狀態，我們再次回到先前的觀察，也就是輝達在每季財報公布前的『季中』交易模式，尤其是財報公布前 2 至 3 周通常會出現一波漲勢。」
他補充表示，「我們注意到，目前正好進入這段財報前期間，而在過去八個季中，這段時間的股價表現一直相當強勁。」
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) extended its rally on Thursday, but ultimately failed to hold onto its intraday gains, according to a report by Barron's. The market believes that the company's upcoming earnings report, to be released later this month, could be the key catalyst to drive the stock price even higher.
Nvidia ended the day down 0.1%, closing at $218.99, marking the end of its five-day winning streak. The stock briefly touched $223.63 before reversing all its gains.
Nvidia was also the largest traded stock on the S&P 500 index and the second-largest traded stock on the Nasdaq 100 index on Thursday.
This year, Nvidia's stock has risen 17.3%, with a cumulative gain of 21% over the past 12 months.

The market may continue to be optimistic about Nvidia's dominance in the AI chip market. One of the latest signs is that Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX (SPACEX-US), recently revealed that the company will fully adopt Nvidia's hardware products in the future.

In addition, Nvidia has a significant lead in the so-called Sovereign AI domain. According to data released by Counterpoint Research on Wednesday, 92% of Sovereign AI models are trained using Nvidia chips.

Nvidia's revenue from Sovereign AI in its 2026 fiscal year has grown more than threefold compared to the same period last year, exceeding $30 billion. The company hopes to continue expanding this business in the future.

Marc Einstein, research director at Counterpoint Research, said, "As the Sovereign AI infrastructure continues to expand, Nvidia is signing multiple multi-billion-dollar deals around the world, hoping to capture the next wave of AI, which is AI inference and building Sovereign AI factories."

The next important catalyst for the market is expected to be Nvidia's earnings report on August 26. The company's stock typically performs strongly before the earnings report is released, but often falls after the report is published, so the market will be watching to see if this trend is broken.

Susquehanna analyst Christopher Jacobson wrote in a research report, "Given that Nvidia's stock price has remained in a downtrend since the last earnings report, we are once again returning to our previous observation, which is Nvidia's 'mid-quarter' trading pattern, especially the 2-3 weeks before the earnings report."
He added, "We note that we are currently in this pre-earnings period, and in the past eight mid-quarters, the stock price has performed extremely strongly."

items.title: 華爾街不信AI紅利能持久？SanDisk、美光估值跌至科技股谷底 6倍本益比引兩派論戰
items.title_en: Wall Street Questions AI Premium Sustainability: SanDisk, Micron Valuations Plummet to Tech Stock Lows
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 帶動高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 與企業級儲存需求爆發，記憶體廠商獲利預估持續上修，但市場給予的估值卻反而降至大型科技股最低水準。SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (Micron Technology) (MU-US) 目前前瞻本益比僅約 6 倍，引發市場討論，究竟是遭到低估，還是反映投資人擔憂記憶體景氣循環終將反轉。
根據市場資料，目前 SanDisk (SNDK-US)以 6.0 倍前瞻本益比，成為美國大型科技股中估值最低的公司；美光科技 (MU-US) 則以 6.3 倍居次。兩家公司今年股價分別累計大漲 444.4% 與 216.1%，但華爾街仍以接近景氣循環谷底企業的估值標準看待兩家公司。
相較之下，GoDaddy (GDDY-US)前瞻本益比為 8.6 倍，今年股價下跌 28.2%；超微電腦 (Super Micro Computer) (SMCI-US) 為 8.9 倍，仍較歷史高點低 75.4%；Adobe (ADBE-US)為 9.9 倍，今年跌 26.7%；Gartner (IT-US)則為 11.7 倍，距歷史高點仍有 68.8% 的差距。
資料來源：Koyfin
值得注意的是，兩家記憶體公司的低估值並非來自獲利預測遭下修，反而是在市場持續調高未來獲利預估的情況下形成。
市場目前預估，SanDisk (SNDK-US)未來 12 個月每股獲利 (EPS) 可達 214.32 美元，較 3 個月前約 168 美元大幅提高 27.6%，但股價仍較歷史高點回落約 46%。
美光科技 (MU-US) 情況亦相似，分析師目前預估未來 12 個月 EPS 將達 144.21 美元，較 3 個月前約 114 美元提高 26.7%，但股價仍較歷史高點低約 29%。
市場人士指出，這代表股價下跌速度遠高於獲利預期上修速度，因此使本益比快速壓縮。
不過，也有分析認為，記憶體向來是半導體產業中景氣循環最劇烈的領域之一，歷史經驗顯示，記憶體股往往正是在獲利接近高峰時，本益比最低。隨著供給逐漸增加、價格回落，企業獲利可能快速下降，屆時目前看似便宜的 6 倍本益比，很可能迅速升高。
然而，AI 是否改變產業循環，正成為市場最大爭論焦點。
在最新財報中，SanDisk (SNDK-US) 表示，公司推動多年期供貨合約與固定價格、保底價格的新商業模式，預估 2027 財年將涵蓋超過一半出貨位元 (bit)，2028 財年可提高至約三分之二，相關長約合計提供 165 億美元財務保障，藉此降低記憶體價格波動風險。
另一方面，美光科技 (MU-US) 近期亦表示，公司已與客戶簽署 16 項長期供貨協議，合約期限延伸至 2030 年。公司最新財測預估本季營收約為 500 億美元，前一季營收則為 414.6 億美元，顯示 AI 需求仍維持強勁。
近期包括美光、SK 海力士及三星電子等主要 HBM 供應商均表示，2026 年與 2027 年高頻寬記憶體產能大多已提前售罄，AI 伺服器持續帶動 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 需求，加上大型雲端服務供應商持續擴大 AI 資料中心投資，使市場開始重新評估記憶體產業是否已進入不同於過去的新景氣循環。
分析人士指出，若 AI 長期需求足以支撐記憶體價格與企業獲利維持高檔，目前約 6 倍的前瞻本益比將顯得相當便宜；反之，若 AI 需求最終仍回歸傳統半導體景氣循環，目前的低估值可能只是反映市場預期獲利接近高峰。
換言之，SanDisk (SNDK-US)與美光科技 (MU-US) 如今已成為 AI 投資熱潮下最具代表性的估值觀察指標，市場真正關心的不只是 AI 需求是否持續成長，而是 AI 是否足以永久改變記憶體產業過去高度循環的商業模式。
paras_en: The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has driven a surge in demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and enterprise storage, leading to profit estimates for memory manufacturers being consistently revised upwards. However, the market's valuation of these companies has plummeted to the lowest level among large tech stocks, sparking debate over whether they are undervalued or reflect investors' concerns about the cyclical nature of the memory industry.

According to market data, SanDisk (SNDK-US) currently has a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 6.0, making it the most undervalued company among US large-cap tech stocks, while Micron Technology (MU-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 6.3. Despite their stock prices increasing by 444.4% and 216.1% respectively this year, Wall Street views both companies as if they were at the bottom of the industry cycle.

In contrast, GoDaddy (GDDY-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.6, with a stock price decline of 28.2% this year; Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 8.9, still lower than its historical high by 75.4%; Adobe (ADBE-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 9.9, with a stock price decline of 26.7%; and Gartner (IT-US) has a forward P/E ratio of 11.7, still 68.8% below its historical high.
Data source: Koyfin
Notably, the low valuations of the two memory companies are not due to downward revisions in profit estimates, but rather the market's continued upward revisions in future earnings estimates.

The market currently estimates that SanDisk (SNDK-US) will achieve earnings per share (EPS) of $214.32 over the next 12 months, a 27.6% increase from the $168 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 46% from its historical high.

Micron Technology (MU-US) has a similar situation, with analysts estimating that the company will achieve EPS of $144.21 over the next 12 months, a 26.7% increase from the $114 estimated three months ago. However, the stock price has fallen by approximately 29% from its historical high.
Market participants point out that this represents a significant compression of the forward P/E ratio, as the stock price decline has outpaced the upward revision in earnings estimates.

However, some analysts argue that the memory industry has historically been one of the most cyclical in the semiconductor industry, with memory stocks often experiencing a low P/E ratio when earnings are near their peak. As supply increases and prices fall, corporate earnings may rapidly decline, making the current 6x forward P/E ratio appear attractive.
However, the question of whether AI will change the industry's cyclical nature has become the biggest point of contention in the market.

In its latest earnings report, SanDisk (SNDK-US) stated that the company has been driving a new business model with multi-year supply contracts and fixed prices, with the goal of covering over half of its output by 2027 and increasing to approximately 3/4 by 2028. This is expected to provide $16.5 billion in financial protection and reduce the risk of memory price volatility.

On the other hand, Micron Technology (MU-US) has recently announced that it has signed 16 long-term supply agreements with customers, with contract terms extending to 2030. The company's latest earnings estimate is $50 billion in revenue for the current quarter and $41.46 billion for the previous quarter, indicating that AI demand remains strong.

Major HBM suppliers, including Micron, SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics, have recently stated that their 2026 and 2027 HBM production capacity is largely sold out, driven by AI server demand and large cloud service providers' continued investment in AI data centers. This has led the market to reassess whether the memory industry has entered a new cycle.

Analysts point out that if AI demand can sustainably support memory prices and corporate earnings at high levels, the current forward P/E ratio of approximately 6 would be considered undervalued. Conversely, if AI demand ultimately returns to traditional semiconductor industry cycles, the current low valuations may simply reflect market expectations of earnings near their peak.

In other words, SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) have become the most representative valuation benchmarks in the AI investment frenzy, with the market's true concern being whether AI can permanently change the memory industry's cyclical business model.

items.title: 法國第二季失業率升至8.3% 創6年新高
items.title_en: France's Q2 Unemployment Rate Rises to 8.3%, Highest in Six Years
paras: 根據法國國家統計局發布的最新數據，法國第二季失業率攀升至 8.3%，不僅高於上一季的 8.1%，也超過了經濟學家預期的 8.2%。
數據顯示，當季失業人數較上季增加 6.2 萬人，達 270 萬人。長期失業率升至 2.1%，為 2022 年第二季以來的最高水準。
同時，15 至 24 歲族群的失業率上升 0.4 個百分點至 21.6%，而 25 至 49 歲族群的失業率攀升至 7.5%。15 至 64 歲族群的就業率下降 0.3 個百分點，至 69%。
勞動市場的惡化給法國總統馬克宏 (Emmanuel Macron) 的政績蒙上了一層陰影。在他第一個 5 年任期內，法國失業率呈下降趨勢。受此鼓舞，馬克宏政府最初設定了在明年第二個任期結束時，實現充分就業的目標。
然而，由於俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭引發的能源價格衝擊，以及如今的伊朗戰爭，法國經濟遭受重創，這一目標已無法實現。
失業率的持續上升可能為明年試圖接替馬克宏的候選人提供政治籌碼。反對派人士長期以來抨擊馬克宏推動的親商減稅和勞動力市場改革，而馬克宏此前一直堅稱這些改革是早期就業增長的動力。
paras_en: According to the latest data released by France's National Institute of Statistics, the unemployment rate for the second quarter rose to 8.3%, higher than the 8.1% recorded in the previous quarter and above economists' forecast of 8.2%.

The figures show that the number of unemployed people increased by 62,000 from the previous quarter, reaching 2.7 million. The long‑term unemployment rate climbed to 2.1%, the highest level since Q2 2022.

At the same time, the unemployment rate for the 15‑to‑24 age group rose by 0.4 percentage points to 21.6%, while the 25‑to‑49 age group saw its rate rise to 7.5%. The employment rate for the 15‑to‑64 age group fell by 0.3 percentage points to 69%.

The deterioration of the labour market has cast a shadow over President Emmanuel Macron's record. During his first five‑year term, France’s unemployment rate had been on a downward trend. Encouraged by that, the Macron administration initially set a goal of achieving full employment by the end of the second term next year.
However, the shock to energy prices caused by Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, together with the current war involving Iran, has dealt a heavy blow to the French economy, making that goal unattainable.

The continued rise in unemployment could provide political ammunition for candidates seeking to succeed Macron next year. Opposition figures have long criticised Macron’s pro‑business tax cuts and labour‑market reforms, while Macron has repeatedly argued that those reforms were the engine of early job growth.

items.title: 德銀看好美光SCA轉型！AI讓記憶體價值占比飆至50% 獲利有上修空間
items.title_en: Deutsche Bank Looks Favorably on Micron's SCA Transformation, AI Boosts Memory Value to 50%
paras: 記憶體股一片低氣壓中，美光 (MU-US) 周四 (5 日) 盤中一度翻紅上揚，雖然最終不敵賣壓收黑，但分析師對美光正在推動的轉型給予高度評價。
美光午盤一度翻紅，終場仍下跌 1.3% 至每股 881.47 美元。其他記憶體股跌幅較重，同樣生產 NAND 快閃記憶體的 Sandisk(SNDK-US)因周三盤後公布的財測不如分析師預期，股價收低 6.8%，SK 海力士 ADR(SKHY-US)跌約 5%，儲存裝置大廠威騰電子 (WDC-US) 因財報不如預期暴跌 13%。
市場雖然對 Sandisk 本季財測低於預期感到失望，但多位華爾街分析師認為，公司透過新的長期供貨協議商業模式，將有助於未來幾年獲利持續成長。

AI 時代 記憶體重要性大增

美光目前也正推動類似轉型，並獲得分析師高度評價。該公司今年 3 月推出名為「策略性客戶協議」(Strategic Customer Agreements, SCA) 的長期供貨模式，可提升需求能見度，同時讓客戶更有把握取得供貨。
德意志銀行 (Deutsche Bank) 分析師 Melissa Weathers 指出，美光「持續演進的商業模式」正是該公司在記憶體市場保持領先的重要原因。
目前 NAND 快閃記憶體與 DRAM 供給依然吃緊，而 AI 需求讓供需失衡的程度比以往景氣循環更嚴重。
Weathers 引述美光管理層說法指出，在供給吃緊環境下，客戶通常會優先確保核心記憶體容量，而非儲存裝置，因為後者仍可透過外接模組擴充，因此記憶體系統的需求彈性更低。
Weathers 表示，根據美光高層提供的訊息，SCA 目的在於降低整體產業供給短缺造成的劇烈波動，預估將涵蓋約 40% 的記憶體出貨量。此外，美光從高頻寬記憶體 (HBM) 到儲存產品擁有完整產品線，使其「得以兼顧成長與獲利」。
Weathers 還認為，市場低估了 AI 時代記憶體在整體系統價值中的重要性：在 AI 興起之前，記憶體約占系統價值 10%，如今已接近 50%。在產品競爭力、新供貨協議以及供需持續吃緊等因素帶動下，她認為美光未來獲利預估仍有上修空間。
paras_en: Despite the downturn in memory stocks, Micron (MU-US) briefly turned positive on Thursday (5th) before ultimately succumbing to selling pressure and closing lower. However, analysts have given high praise to the transformation that Micron is driving.

Micron's stock briefly turned positive during mid-day trading but ultimately closed 1.3% lower at $881.47 per share. Other memory stocks fell more sharply, with Sandisk (SNDK-US), which also produces NAND flash memory, closing 6.8% lower after releasing a disappointing earnings forecast after the market closed on Wednesday. SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell approximately 5%, and storage device manufacturer Western Digital (WDC-US) plummeted 13% due to a disappointing earnings report.

Although the market was disappointed by Sandisk's lower-than-expected earnings forecast, several Wall Street analysts believe that the company's new long-term supply agreement business model will help drive sustained profit growth over the next few years.

In the AI era, the importance of memory has increased significantly. Micron is also undergoing a similar transformation and has received high praise from analysts. In March, the company launched a long-term supply model called 'Strategic Customer Agreements' (SCA), which can improve demand visibility and give customers more confidence in their supply chain.
Deutsche Bank analyst Melissa Weathers pointed out that Micron's 'evolving business model' is a key reason why the company remains a leader in the memory market.
Currently, the supply of NAND flash memory and DRAM remains tight, and AI demand has exacerbated the supply and demand imbalance to a greater extent than in previous economic cycles.

Weathers cited Micron's management as saying that in a tight supply environment, customers typically prioritize core memory capacity over storage devices, which can still be expanded through external modules, making memory systems less elastic in demand.

Weathers stated that according to information provided by Micron's management, the purpose of SCA is to reduce the severe fluctuations caused by industry-wide supply shortages, which is expected to cover around 40% of memory shipments. Additionally, Micron's comprehensive product line, from high-bandwidth memory (HBM) to storage products, enables the company to 'balance growth and profitability'.

Weathers also believes that the market has underestimated the importance of memory in the overall system value in the AI era: before the rise of AI, memory accounted for around 10% of system value, but now it is close to 50%. Driven by factors such as product competitiveness, new supply agreements, and ongoing tight supply and demand, she believes that Micron's future earnings estimates still have room for upward revision.

items.title: WSJ：針對五角大廈彈藥短缺報導 川普已下令徹查「洩密者」
paras: 根據《華爾街日報》周四 (6 日) 援引政府官員的話報導，美國總統川普已下令對有關五角大樓軍火儲備遭披露一事，展開新的調查。此前數周，媒體報導稱，川普因為彈藥庫存短缺，而痛批國防部長 (Pete Hegseth)。
然而，在媒體報導此事後，川普對此類消息外洩感到極度沮喪與憤怒，認為這使美國在與伊朗對峙的關鍵時刻顯得軟弱，進而削弱了華盛頓向德黑蘭施壓的努力。
對於赫格瑟斯，川普則表達信任，並將庫存問題歸咎於前任政府對烏克蘭的軍援。
川普在社群媒體上公開抨擊洩密者是「叛國者」，並揚言要讓這些人面臨長期監禁。儘管川普坦承部分高端彈藥的供應確實較為「吃緊」，但他強調美國仍擁有「巨量的彈藥」，且目前正以歷史性的規模擴建工廠以加速生產。
白宮發言人 Karoline Leavitt 也重申，美軍目前擁有「綽綽有餘的火力」，來執行任何軍事行動。
然而，媒體引述消息指出，美軍在「史詩憤怒行動」(Operation Epic Fury) 及隨後的空襲中，消耗了大量精準飛彈。智庫研究估計，美軍愛國者飛彈庫存已降至衝突前的三分之一，THAAD 攔截飛彈也消耗了約六成。這引發了海灣盟友的擔憂，擔心防空系統短缺會影響其抵禦伊朗報復的能力。
與此同時，伊朗國防部則藉此宣稱美軍實力正在衰減，並強調其本土防禦技術更具優勢。
為了解決產能問題，川普政府已向國會申請 870 億美元的緊急資金，用於支付軍事人員開支並迅速補充裝備與彈藥庫存。

items.title: 不怕業界反對！韓國交易所強推9/14盤後ETF上路 對決虛擬資產交易所與ATS
items.title_en: Unafraid of Industry Opposition! Korean Exchange Pushes Post‑Market ETF Launch on Sep 14, Pitting It Against Crypto Exchanges and ATS
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，儘管業界對近期槓桿類產品波動存在擔憂，韓國交易所 (KRX) 仍將於 9 月 14 日正式開啟 ETF 盤後交易，意在與另類交易系統 (ATS) 業者 Nextrade 及全天候加密貨幣交易所競爭。
對此資管機構示警，無法精準計算即時盤後淨值 (NAV) 估算，恐擴大 ETF 價格背離幅度，但據悉 KRX 已拍板推進並正式要求投信提交可盤後交易 ETF 名單。此前，業界已呼籲 KRX 延後該業務上線，個股槓桿型 ETF 將不納入盤後交易的交易標的範圍。
《朝鮮日報》報導，KRX 堅持上路，部分源於 ATS 業者 Nextrade(NXT)壓力，NXT 每日交易 12 小時 (盤前 8:00-8:50、盤後 15:40-20:00)，KRX 在交易時數上居劣。NXT 目前還不能交易 ETF，要等金管當局全套核准(11、12 月有望獲批) 實際開跑，未來 3-4 個月 KRX 享壟斷窗口，某投信高層稱「KRX 想在這段領先期將先發優勢最大化」。
代幣化證券 (STO) 逼近也加劇與 24 小時虛擬資產平台的競爭，其核心訴求正是「24 小時交易＋即時交割」。含 STO 條文的《電子證券法》修正案在今年 1 月國會闖關通過，明年 2 月 4 日生效。一旦分散式帳本證券入市，虛擬資產交易所與代幣證券平台將正面交鋒。
美國方面，美國證交會 (SEC) 已准那斯達克交易所上鏈代幣化交易、紐約證交所獲准開發鏈上交割平台，那斯達克的 23 小時交易計畫 (日盤 4:00-20:00、夜盤 21:00 - 翌日 4:00) 在 4 月過關，兩家目標年底上線。
資管界憂心收盤後估計淨值 (iNAV) 算不準，擴大市價與淨值裂口。iNAV 靠標的即時價格估算，正規盤由 KOSCOM 即時供數。今年 4 月，KRX 決定盤前盤後不披露 iNAV，改由流動性提供商 (LP) 算公允價報價，義務同正規盤。
但業界反駁：LP 收盤後算 4 小時公允價需增加人手與系統，多數券商會避開成本；創贖回基礎建設也未齊備。沒 iNAV，純靠交易撮合的價格易大幅偏離。
上周三 (7 月 29 日)，南韓八大投信執行長與八大證券主管在金投協會長黃成燁主持下會談，傳達審慎共識。
與此同時，近期 ETF 市場萎縮增添隱憂，上月底南韓國內 ETF 總淨值 434.615 兆韓元，較 6 月底 512.408 兆蒸發 15.2%，或 77.793 兆韓元，單月跌破 500 兆關卡，上周四 (7 月 30 日) 隨股災再摔至 398.0339 兆、失守 400 兆。
1138 檔 ETF 中，891 檔上月收跌，531 檔跌逾 10%。上周五 (7 月 31 日) 提早上路的單股槓桿產品管制更澆冷水，管制後 4 日均量 1.6991 兆韓元，較前 5 日 10.7305 兆暴降 84%。
KRX 近日也通知主要投信業者，8 月新 ETF 掛牌恐因法規審查積壓、工作量暴增而延遲。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that despite industry concerns over recent volatility in leveraged products, the Korea Exchange (KRX) will officially launch post‑market ETF trading on September 14, aiming to compete with alternative trading system (ATS) operator Nextrade and all‑day cryptocurrency exchanges.

Asset managers warn that real‑time post‑market net asset value (NAV) cannot be calculated accurately, which could widen ETF price deviations, but KRX has already decided to move forward and formally asked fund companies to submit lists of ETFs eligible for post‑market trading. The industry had previously called for KRX to delay the rollout, and single‑stock leveraged ETFs will not be included in the post‑market trading universe.

The Chosun Ilbo reports that KRX is pressing ahead partly due to pressure from ATS operator Nextrade (ticker NXT). Nextrade trades 12 hours a day (pre‑market 08:00‑08:50, post‑market 15:40‑20:00), putting KRX at a disadvantage in trading hours. Nextrade cannot yet trade ETFs; it must wait for full regulatory approval, expected in November or December, before launching. For the next three to four months KRX will enjoy a monopoly window, and a senior fund executive said, “KRX wants to maximise its first‑mover advantage during this lead‑time.”

The approaching tokenised securities (STO) market intensifies competition with 24‑hour virtual‑asset platforms, whose core appeal is “24‑hour trading + instant settlement.” An amendment to the Electronic Securities Act that includes STO provisions cleared parliament in January and will take effect on February 4 next year. Once distributed‑ledger securities enter the market, crypto exchanges and token‑security platforms will face direct head‑to‑head competition.

In the United States, the SEC has approved Nasdaq’s on‑chain tokenised trading and the NYSE’s development of an on‑chain settlement platform. Nasdaq’s 23‑hour trading plan (day session 04:00‑20:00, night session 21:00‑04:00 the next day) cleared in April, with both firms targeting a year‑end launch.

Asset managers worry that post‑close estimated NAV (iNAV) will be inaccurate, widening the gap between market price and NAV. iNAV is derived from real‑time prices of the underlying assets, with regular session data supplied instantly by KOSCOM. In April this year KRX decided not to publish iNAV for pre‑ and post‑market sessions, instead delegating fair‑value pricing to liquidity providers (LPs), who bear the same obligations as in the regular session.

The industry pushes back, saying LPs would need extra staff and systems to calculate a four‑hour post‑close fair price, which most broker‑dealers would avoid due to cost; the creation/redemption infrastructure is also not ready. Without iNAV, prices derived solely from trade matching can deviate significantly from true value.

Last Wednesday (July 29), CEOs of South Korea’s eight largest fund companies and heads of the eight biggest securities firms met under the chairmanship of Kim T’ong‑ye, head of the Korea Financial Investment Association, to convey a consensus of caution.

At the same time, a recent contraction in the ETF market adds to concerns. At the end of last month, total domestic ETF net assets in South Korea stood at KRW 434.615 trillion, a 15.2% drop from KRW 512.408 trillion at the end of June—a loss of KRW 77.793 trillion—falling below the KRW 500 trillion threshold. By Thursday, July 30, amid a stock market crash, assets fell further to KRW 398.0339 trillion, breaking the KRW 400 trillion mark.

Of the 1,138 ETFs, 891 fell in price last month and 531 dropped more than 10%. On Friday, July 31, tighter regulation of single‑stock leveraged products—released early—further cooled the market; average daily turnover fell to KRW 1.6991 trillion over the four days after the rule change, down 84% from the previous five‑day average of KRW 10.7305 trillion.
KRX recently notified major fund managers that new ETFs slated for listing in August may be delayed due to a backlog of regulatory reviews and a surge in workload.

items.title: 菲律賓第二季經濟增速創5年新低 營建業低迷與高通膨成主因
items.title_en: Philippines' Q2 Economic Growth Hits 5-Year Low Due to Sluggish Construction and High Inflation
paras: 菲律賓統計局周五 (7 日) 公布，菲律賓 2026 年第二季 GDP 年增率僅為 2.3%。這一數據不僅低於媒體調查預期的 2.8%，更創下自 2021 年以來最弱的年率增幅。
經濟放緩的主要原因，在於營建業的大幅下滑及國內需求的轉弱。受去年爆發的防洪工程貪污醜聞影響，公共支出受限，投資者信心受挫，導致第二季營建業萎縮 14.8%，且整體投資額已連四季下滑，跌幅達 9.2%。
同時，占經濟活動三分之二以上的家庭支出增長也放緩至 2.8%，主因是今年前七個月平均通膨率高達 5.0%，嚴重侵蝕了民眾的購買力。
在農業領域，第二季產出成長率為 2.9%，相較去年同期的 6.0% 明顯放緩，但優於第一季的萎縮狀態。雖然家禽業 (成長 6.3%) 和畜牧業 (成長 3.6%) 表現尚可，但甘蔗產出驟降 22.5%，且面臨灌溉系統功能不彰的挑戰。此外，即將到來的「超級聖嬰現象」預計將在下半年對農作物生產和飼料價格造成負面衝擊。
儘管上半年平均經濟成長率僅 2.6%，低於政府設定的 3.5% 至 4.5% 年度目標，但經濟規劃部長 Arsenio Balisacan 仍表示持「審慎樂觀」態度。政府預期，隨着新批准的基礎設施項目啟動，本季支出將會回升。
菲律賓中央銀行將於 8 月 27 日舉行政策會議，屆時需在「支持經濟增長」與「對抗通膨」之間力求平衡。
paras_en: The Philippine Statistics Authority announced on Friday that the country's GDP growth rate for the second quarter of 2026 was only 2.3%, which is not only lower than the media's expected 2.8% but also the weakest annual growth rate since 2021.

The main reason for the economic slowdown is the significant decline in the construction industry and the weakening of domestic demand. The corruption scandal in the flood control project last year has limited public spending, damaging investor confidence and resulting in a 14.8% contraction in the construction industry in the second quarter, with overall investment declining for the fourth consecutive quarter by 9.2%.

At the same time, household spending, which accounts for more than two-thirds of economic activity, has also slowed down to 2.8%, mainly due to the high average inflation rate of 5.0% in the first seven months of the year, which has severely eroded people's purchasing power.

In the agricultural sector, the growth rate of output in the second quarter was 2.9%, which is a significant slowdown compared to the 6.0% in the same period last year, but better than the contraction in the first quarter. Although the poultry industry (growing 6.3%) and livestock industry (growing 3.6%) performed well, sugarcane production plummeted 22.5%, and the irrigation system is facing challenges. Furthermore, the upcoming 'super El Niño phenomenon' is expected to have a negative impact on crop production and feed prices in the second half of the year.

Despite the average economic growth rate of only 2.6% in the first half of the year, which is lower than the government's target of 3.5% to 4.5%, Economic Planning Secretary Arsenio Balisacan remains 'cautiously optimistic'. The government expects that with the newly approved infrastructure projects, spending will rebound this quarter.
The Philippine central bank will hold a policy meeting on August 27, at which time it will need to strike a balance between 'supporting economic growth' and 'fighting inflation'.

items.title: 銅價飆出歷史新高！「銅博士」為何不再單純是經濟晴雨表？
items.title_en: Copper Price Soars to New High: Why 'Dr. Copper' is No Longer a Simple Economic Indicator?
paras: 國際銅價周四 (6 日) 飆上歷史新高，但這波漲勢背後的經濟成長訊號卻更加複雜，也讓素有經濟健康晴雨表之稱的「銅博士」(Dr. Copper)變得更難解讀。
剛果民主共和國為了推動國內加工產業發展，正式宣布禁止銅、鈷精礦出口後出現，使銅價飆上新高，美國銅期貨周四一度漲至每磅約 6.90 美元，但之後回落，終場走低。
銅廣泛應用於營建、電子、運輸甚至人工智慧 (AI) 領域，這使銅礦常被視為全球經濟活動是否升溫的指標。如今的高價可能反映的是供給受限、大規模電網投資、美國關稅政策的不確定性，以及電氣化需求增加等多重因素，而不單純代表全球經濟成長強勁。
Barchart 商品資料研究與分析主管 William Osnato 說：「支撐銅價維持高檔的核心因素，是資料中心與電網需求，這些需求是為了支應 AI 產業快速擴張。」他指出，銅需求的這波增長「更加集中，並非傳統上支撐銅價的廣泛經濟成長」。

供給吃緊成銅價上漲關鍵

銅價飆升也與供給有限有關。銅礦開採成本高昂，且從建設新礦到正式投產往往需要約 10 年，進一步限制供給增加的速度。
美國銀行金屬研究主管 Michael Widmer 表示，這波漲勢其實與其說是銅需求帶動，不如說是供給推動。目前礦山供給成長有限，加上供應中斷，都讓市場更加緊縮。全球最大單一銅生產國智利，近期因為大雪、強降雨及強風，都讓當地採礦作業大受影響。
此外，美國可能祭出《貿易擴張法》第 232 條關稅，以及中國收緊廢銅供應，都進一步壓縮 2026 年全球銅供給。美國總統川普去年 6 月簽署公告，對半成品銅產品及高銅含量衍生產品進口課徵 50% 關稅。

電氣化需求仍強勁

銅需求依然穩健，但主要與電氣化趨勢密切相關，卻不一定代表整體經濟正在蓬勃成長。
中國上半年的電網投資年增 13%，不久前還宣布雄心勃勃的電網升級計畫，預計投資約 5740 億美元。
Barchart 的 Osnato 表示，供應中斷正促使消費者從倫敦金屬交易所 (LME) 倉庫提取銅金屬，並推高精煉成本，「對銅博士而言，這確實是一種全新的局面。」
paras_en: International copper prices soared to a new high on Thursday (6th), but the economic growth signals behind this surge are more complex, making the 'copper doctor' (Dr. Copper) harder to read.

The Democratic Republic of Congo's decision to ban copper and cobalt ore exports to boost domestic processing industries led to the price surge, with US copper futures rising to around $6.90 per pound on Thursday, only to fall back and close lower.

Copper is widely used in construction, electronics, transportation, and artificial intelligence (AI) fields, making copper mines a benchmark for global economic activity. The current high price may reflect supply constraints, large-scale grid investments, uncertainty over US tariffs, and increasing demand for electrification, rather than simply representing strong global economic growth.

Barchart's commodity data research and analysis manager William Osnato said, 'The core factors supporting copper prices at high levels are data center and grid demand, driven by the rapid expansion of the AI industry.' He noted that copper demand growth is more concentrated and not driven by traditional broad-based economic growth.

Tight supply is a key factor in copper price surge. Copper mining costs are high, and it takes around 10 years to build a new mine and bring it into production, further limiting the speed of supply growth.

US Bank's metals research manager Michael Widmer said that this surge is more driven by supply than demand. Current mine supply growth is limited, and supply disruptions have further tightened the market. Chile, the world's largest single copper-producing country, has been affected by recent heavy snow, strong rainfall, and strong winds, which have severely impacted local mining operations.

Additionally, the US may impose tariffs under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, and China's tightening of scrap copper supplies will further compress global copper supply in 2026. US President Trump signed an announcement in June last year, imposing a 50% tariff on imported semi-finished copper products and high-copper-content derivative products.
Copper demand remains stable but is closely related to the electrification trend, which does not necessarily represent overall economic growth.
China's first-half electricity network investment grew by 13%, and it recently announced a ambitious electricity network upgrade plan, with an investment of around $574 billion.

Barchart's Osnato said that supply disruptions are prompting consumers to extract copper metal from the London Metal Exchange (LME) warehouses, pushing up refining costs, 'This is indeed a new scenario for Dr. Copper.'

items.title: 美零售商折價出售關稅退稅權 以確保先拿到現金
items.title_en: US Retailers Discount Tax Refund Rights to Ensure Cash Flow
paras: 在美國最高法院裁定部分關稅違法後，許多企業原本可領回巨額退款，但因政府核發程序緩慢且充滿不確定性，業者面臨現金流壓力，正採取一種非典型的融資策略，寧願大幅折扣將未來的關稅退稅權出售給第三方買家，以換取即時的現金流注入。
根據《華爾街日報》與《Retail Dive》報導，包括 GoPro、American Eagle Outfitters 以及 The Children’s Place 在內的多家企業，已陸續與買家達成協議，轉讓價值數百萬美元的關稅退稅債權。
其中，American Eagle Outfitters 的做法最具代表性，該公司在其 2026 年第一季報告中透露，已將價值 6,890 萬美元的關稅退稅債權，以 1,860 萬美元的價格折價出售，換取現金流入。
另一家零售商 The Children’s Place 表示，公司支付了約 4,000 萬美元的關稅，並已同意將其中 3,820 萬美元的退稅債權轉讓給 Alnus Investors，換取 2,570 萬美元的資金。運動用品商 Academy Sports & Outdoors 同樣出售了部分債權以獲取約 1,050 萬美元，並保留部分向政府申請退稅的權利。
這股趨勢背後的主要原因，在於聯邦政府退稅進度緩慢。儘管美國最高法院於 2026 年 2 月裁定川普依據《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA) 徵收的關稅違法，但向美國海關及邊境保衛局 (CBP) 申請退稅的過程極其艱辛且漫長。 截至 7 月底，政府已退還約 1,000 億美元關稅，僅占總徵收額 1,660 億美元的 60%。
財務諮詢公司 BDO 的執行董事 David Wong 指出，這類交易對賣方而言最大的風險在於時間的不確定性。企業必須在「等待更長時間以獲得全額退稅」與「立即獲得較少資金」之間做出權衡。對於急需現金緩衝的零售商來說，即使損失部分潛在金額，現金融資帶來的靈活性仍具吸引力。
與此同時，貿易爭議仍未平息。雖然先前的關稅被裁定違法，但川普仍試圖透過 1974 年《貿易法》重啟關稅政策，目前已引發至少 25 個州政府與多個小企業團體提起訴訟。
paras_en: After the US Supreme Court ruled that some tariffs were illegal, many companies that could have received large refunds faced cash flow pressure due to the slow and uncertain government reimbursement process. To address this, they are adopting an unconventional financing strategy, opting to significantly discount their future tax refund rights to third-party buyers in exchange for immediate cash injections.

According to reports by The Wall Street Journal and Retail Dive, several companies, including GoPro, American Eagle Outfitters, and The Children's Place, have reached agreements with buyers to transfer tax refund rights valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

American Eagle Outfitters' approach is particularly representative, as the company disclosed in its first-quarter 2026 report that it had sold tax refund rights valued at $689 million for $186 million, securing cash inflow.

Another retailer, The Children's Place, stated that it paid approximately $400 million in tariffs and agreed to transfer $382 million in refund rights to Alnus Investors in exchange for $257 million in capital. Academy Sports & Outdoors, a sporting goods retailer, also sold part of its rights to obtain approximately $105 million and retained the right to apply for refunds from the government.

The underlying reason for this trend is the slow pace of federal refunds. Although the US Supreme Court ruled in February 2026 that tariffs imposed by Trump under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) were illegal, the process of applying for refunds from US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is extremely difficult and lengthy. As of July 31, the government had returned approximately $100 billion in tariffs, accounting for only 60% of the total $166 billion collected.

David Wong, an executive director at financial consulting firm BDO, noted that the main risk for sellers in these transactions is the uncertainty of time. Companies must weigh the option of waiting longer to receive full refunds against receiving less capital immediately. For retailers that urgently need cash buffers, the flexibility provided by immediate financing is attractive, even if it means losing some potential value.

Meanwhile, trade disputes remain unresolved. Although the previous tariffs were ruled illegal, Trump is attempting to revive tariff policies under the 1974 Trade Act, which has led to at least 25 state governments and multiple small business groups filing lawsuits.

items.title: 史上最缺一年將至？記憶體三巨頭把2027產能賣光 消息人士：一些AI公司已在「跪求晶片」
items.title_en: DRAM Shortage to Worsen in 2027 as Memory Giants Sell Out
paras: 隨著 AI 資本開支狂飆，全球 DRAM/HBM 產能遭提前掃貨。多家媒體彙整供應鏈消息指出，三星、SK 海力士、美光已經完成 2027 全年產能分配談判，DRAM 與 HBM 產線「提前售罄」，多數客戶最終配貨僅拿到一開始請求的 60%-70%，三家均無新增產線規劃，NAND 則因供應商較多，買方尚有零星談判空間，但整體仍緊俏。
夏季本是採購未來一年零組件旺季，今年卻上演「全年產能歸零」戲碼，凸顯 AI 伺服器、GPU 叢集與端側 Agent 對記憶體的吞噬速度。
SK 集團會長崔泰源近期直言，2027 年 AI 半導體需求較今年增加 60%-100%、整體記憶體需求增 50%-60%，「將是史上最嚴峻短缺與供需失衡」。
資深業內人士判斷，2026 年缺口已現，明年將從缺口擴大成結構性斷層。
溢價搶料已經開始。部分 AI 新創公司「跪求」最後批次，願付高於合約價換優先出貨，但晶圓物理極限卡死供給曲線。
與此同時，成本傳導鏈清晰；記憶體漲價→主機漲價→手機漲價。微軟本週調升 Xbox Series X/S 最高 150 美元，任天堂打算 9 月起調高 Switch 2 美國售價，離蘋果 iPhone 18 Pro 發表僅剩幾周，1399 美元起售價幾乎成市場共識，DRAM 斷料還可能拖累首銷現貨。
當「硬體老化降價」規律被記憶體超級週期推翻，消費電子正集體進入「越賣越貴」的新定價時代，而 2027 年才是壓力頂峰。
paras_en: Global DRAM and HBM production capacity has been depleted ahead of schedule, with Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron completing their 2027 annual production allocation negotiations. DRAM and HBM production lines have been sold out, with most customers receiving only 60-70% of their initial orders. The three companies have no plans to add new production lines, while NAND production has more suppliers, leaving some room for negotiation, but the overall market remains tight.

The summer season is typically a peak time for purchasing components for the next year, but this year has seen a 'zero production capacity' scenario, highlighting the rapid consumption of memory by AI servers, GPU clusters, and edge agents.

SK Group Chairman Choi Tae-won recently stated that AI semiconductor demand in 2027 will increase by 60-100% compared to this year, with overall memory demand increasing by 50-60%. He described it as 'the most severe shortage and supply imbalance in history'.
Industry insiders believe that the shortage has already begun in 2026 and will worsen in 2027, becoming a structural gap.

Price gouging has already started, with some AI startups 'kneeling' to request the last batch, willing to pay more than the contract price for priority delivery, but the physical limits of silicon are capping the supply curve.

Meanwhile, the cost transmission chain is clear: memory price increases → mainboard price increases → smartphone price increases. Microsoft has raised the price of Xbox Series X/S by up to $150 this week, while Nintendo plans to increase the price of Switch 2 in the US from September. The price of Apple's iPhone 18 Pro, which is set to be released in a few weeks, is expected to start at $1,399, almost a market consensus, and DRAM shortages may further delay the availability of new products.

As the 'hardware aging and price reduction' rule is being overturned by the memory supercycle, the consumer electronics industry is entering a new pricing era where 'the more you sell, the more expensive it gets', and 2027 is expected to be the peak of the pressure.

items.title: 日元已回吐近半干預漲幅 美日匯率保衛戰恐還有第二輪要打
items.title_en: Yen Gives Back Nearly Half of Intervention Gain, Fears of Second Round of Intervention Rise
paras: 日元兌美元匯率在經歷美日聯合干預後的強勁反彈後，近期已回吐近半漲幅，引發市場對於當局是否會發動「第二輪保衛戰」的熱烈討論。
截至周五下午，日元兌美元匯率跌至 158.40 附近，遠低於周一創下的 155.23 強勢高點。就在上周，日元兌美元一度逼近 164 的四十年低點，隨後引發日本與美國自 1998 年以來的首次聯合買入日元行動。
此次匯率回調凸顯了單純干預手段，在扭轉日元長期貶值趨勢上的局限性。美日之間顯著的利差、日本沉重的債務負擔，以及地緣政治不確定性均持續向日元施壓。隨著中東局勢導致油價上漲，市場對緊張局勢緩和的樂觀情緒減弱，支撐美元周四錄得兩周來最大單日漲幅。
市場分析指出，隨著匯率再度逼近 160 的關鍵整數關口，當局再次出手干預的可能性極高。
澳洲聯邦銀行策略師 Carol Kong 警告，若日元跌破 160 關口而當局未採取行動，將鼓勵交易員重新建立日元空頭部位，這正是政策制定者極力想避免的結果。事實上，日本在春季黃金周期間已曾三次干預匯市，顯示出其最大化心理衝擊的決心。
然而，干預的長效性仍取決於貨幣政策的配合。華僑銀行策略師 Moh Siong Sim 認為，干預若要發揮實質效果，必須配合日本央行更激進的升息，或是聯準會轉向寬鬆政策。目前，隔夜指數掉期顯示日本央行在 9 月前升息的機率約為 60%。
日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，當局將協調匯率走勢與貨幣政策共同應對。
展望未來，美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 的「不惜一切代價」言論，暗示干預行動並非一次性事件。投資者目前正密切關注即將公布的美國非農就業報告與通膨數據，這些數據將成為決定日元是否會面臨新一輪拋售壓力的關鍵催化劑。
paras_en: The yen has given back nearly half of its gain since the joint intervention by Japan and the US, sparking heated discussions about whether the authorities will launch a second round of intervention.

As of Friday afternoon, the yen traded at around 158.40, far below the strong high of 155.23 set on Monday. Just last week, the yen briefly approached a 40-year low of 164, prompting Japan and the US to take their first joint action to buy yen since 1998.

The recent reversal of the yen's rate highlights the limitations of relying solely on intervention to reverse the yen's long-term depreciation trend. The significant interest rate differential between the US and Japan, Japan's heavy debt burden, and geopolitical uncertainty all continue to put pressure on the yen. With the Middle East situation driving up oil prices, market optimism about easing tensions has weakened, supporting the dollar's two-week high on Thursday.
Market analysts point out that with the yen rate again approaching the key integer threshold of 160, the possibility of the authorities intervening again is extremely high.

Australian Federal Bank strategist Carol Kong warns that if the yen breaks below the 160 threshold without intervention, it will encourage traders to rebuild yen short positions, which is exactly what policymakers are trying to avoid. In fact, Japan has intervened in the currency market three times during the spring golden period, showing its determination to maximize psychological impact.

However, the long-term effectiveness of intervention still depends on the coordination of monetary policy. OCBC Bank strategist Moh Siong Sim believes that intervention will only have a real impact if it is accompanied by the Bank of Japan's more aggressive interest rate hikes or the Fed's shift to a more accommodative policy. Currently, the overnight index swap shows that the Bank of Japan has a 60% chance of raising interest rates before September.
Japan's top foreign exchange official, Mitsuru Miyazawa, said that the authorities will coordinate the exchange rate trend with monetary policy to respond together.

Looking ahead, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's 'no matter what' comments suggest that intervention is not a one-time event. Investors are closely watching the upcoming US non-farm payroll and inflation data, which will be key catalysts for determining whether the yen will face a new round of selling pressure.

items.title: 先斬後奏！ FT：美賣歐元推高日元   歐洲央行直到交易執行才收到華府通知
items.title_en: FT: US Sells Euro to Boost Yen, ECB Only Notified After Fact
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國上週五 (7 月 31 日) 為提振日元而賣出歐元的操作，令歐洲央行 (ECB) 措手不及，因華府在這筆歷史性匯市干預執行完畢後，才通知法蘭克福方面。
《金融時報》今 (7) 日引述多位消息人士報導，ECB 是在上週五交易成交後，才得知美國出售歐元、買入日元的動向，ECB 總裁拉加德與美國財長貝森特也在隔天就此次干預通話。
報導指出，這種「先斬後奏」凸顯出近 30 年來美日首度聯手護匯的不尋常。按戰後西方貨幣當局慣例，美國若介入匯市通常動用美元，而非動用歐元。
部分 ECB 高層認為，華府改用歐元交易，是對西方央行長期合作慣例的「空前違背」。
一名了解歐洲決策層討論的人士形容，紐約聯準銀行代表美國財政部執行的賣歐元行動「非常引人注目」且「令人遺憾」，並稱「這種事從未發生過」，二戰後西方靠互信與事前磋商維繫的匯市協調傳統，可能正受威脅。
美國財政部發言人表示，透過「匯率穩定基金」(ESF) 配置儲備資產的決定由華府自作主張，不與外國當局協調。「ESF 資產配置由財政部依市場流動性、估值等評估定奪」，上週透過 ESF 在內部重配準備資產屬職權範圍。
一名白宮官員更說：「我們尊重與國際同僚私下討論的機密性，不像 ECB。」
華府選擇賣歐元而非賣美元，主因是怕拋美元被解讀為弱勢美元信號、打臉貝森特「強勢美元政策」。
分析師也揣測，美國陪日本出手，是想避免後者在美債殖利率逼近 19 年高點時賣債換美元。
日本在 7 月最後兩天估計耗資約 13.8 兆日元 (870 億美元)，已超過 4-5 月創下的 11.73 兆日元舊紀錄。
美日上週五聯手把美元兌日元從近 164(1986 年以來低點) 拉回 157，其後略貶至 158。
市場仍憂心日本央行 (BOJ) 升息太慢，BOJ 總裁植田和男上月會議按兵不動，但坦言「通膨上行風險需更關注」，市場看好下月升息機率約 44%。
美國這次「用歐元救日元」的非常規操作，短期震懾套利空頭，卻也讓西方貨幣協調的信任底線露出一道裂痕。
paras_en: A US operation to boost the yen by selling euros last Friday (July 31) caught the European Central Bank (ECB) off guard, as Washington only notified Frankfurt after the historic intervention.

The Financial Times reported on July 7 that the ECB only learned of the US sale of euros and purchase of yen after the trade was completed on Friday, with ECB President Christine Lagarde and US Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin speaking about the intervention the following day.
The 'shoot first, tell later' approach highlights the unusual nature of the US-Japan alliance to defend their currencies, which has not happened in nearly 30 years.
Some ECB officials view the US decision to use euros in the intervention as a 'historic breach' of the long-standing cooperation between Western central banks.

A person familiar with the European decision-making process described the New York Federal Reserve's sale of euros as 'highly unusual' and 'regrettable', saying 'this has never happened before', and that the post-war tradition of Western currency coordination based on trust and prior consultation may be under threat.

A US Treasury spokesperson said that the decision to use the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) to allocate reserve assets was made by Washington without coordination with foreign authorities, stating that 'ESF asset allocation is determined by the Treasury Department based on market liquidity, valuation, and other assessments'.
A White House official added that 'we respect the confidentiality of private discussions with international colleagues, unlike the ECB'.
The US chose to sell euros instead of dollars to avoid being seen as a sign of a weak dollar, which would undermine Mnuchin's 'strong dollar policy'.
Analysts speculate that the US joined Japan to avoid the latter selling bonds and buying dollars when US bond yields approached a 19-year high.
Japan is estimated to have spent around ¥13.8 trillion (approximately $870 billion) in the last two days of July, exceeding the previous record of ¥11.73 trillion set in April-May.
The US and Japan jointly pushed the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 164 (a 1986 low) back to 157 on Friday, and it later fell to 158.

Markets remain concerned that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may be raising interest rates too slowly, with BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda saying in a recent meeting that 'the risk of inflation rising is more pressing', and market expectations for a rate hike in August are around 44%.
The US's unconventional use of euros to rescue the yen has temporarily shaken out short sellers, but has also exposed a crack in the trust between Western currency coordinators.

items.title: 今年干預次數額度疑似用完！日本黃金週期間三度出手護日元 Q2砸11.74兆創單季新高
items.title_en: Intervention Quota Seems Exhausted! Japan Acts Three Times During Golden Week to Support Yen, Q2 Intervention Hits 11.74 Trillion Yen, a New Quarterly Record
paras: 日本財務省今 (7) 日公佈今年第二季每日干預明細，證實在 4 月 30 日、5 月 4 日、5 月 6 日三度買入日元，金額分別為 6.28 兆、0.78 兆、4.68 兆日元，合計 11.74 兆日元(約 785 億美元)，創日本歷次匯市防衛單季最高規模。
根據日本財務省數據，今年第二季較上月底美日聯手多出一輪單邊操作，且確認除上述三天外，黃金週期間曾有五次盤中急貶，當局未做其他平滑干預。出手干預前，日元兌美元匯率跌破 160，三輪出手後匯價拉回 155 附近。
日本財務省數據加上週五 (7 月 31 日) 與華府協同買進日元，市場推算日本在 IMF 規則下的 2026 會計年度干預額度已觸頂，與華府聯手觸發「六個月冷卻期」重置機制。理論上，日本直到 2027 年初前，不能再次單邊進場。
對日元套利交易者，干預額度疑似用罄是明確綠燈，空頭不必再防「隨時有 8 兆級砸盤」，倉位回補意願上升。
但部分投資人存疑，川普時代「基於規則的干預框架」實際約束力弱化，若日元再破 165，華府是否默許東京破例或改以口頭 + 美債端配合，仍留灰色地帶。
短期看，匯市波動率料將回落，但 2027 前「無干預承諾」本身，也可能成為下一輪空頭加槓桿的催化。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance today (the 7th) released the daily intervention details for the second quarter of this year, confirming three yen purchases on April 30, May 4, and May 6, amounting to 6.28 trillion, 0.78 trillion, and 4.68 trillion yen respectively, for a total of 11.74 trillion yen (about $78.5 billion), the largest single‑quarter foreign‑exchange market defence operation in Japan's history.

According to Ministry data, the second quarter saw one more unilateral operation compared with the end of last month’s US‑Japan joint effort, and besides the three days above, there were five intraday sharp depreciations during Golden Week that the authorities did not smooth with additional intervention. Before the interventions, the yen‑dollar rate had fallen below 160, and after the three rounds it rebounded to around 155.

Combined with the coordinated yen purchase with Washington on Friday (July 31), market participants estimate that Japan’s intervention quota for the 2026 fiscal year under IMF rules has been reached, triggering a “six‑month cooling‑off” reset mechanism with the U.S. In theory, Japan cannot make another unilateral entry until early 2027.

For yen arbitrage traders, the apparent depletion of the intervention quota is a clear green light; short sellers no longer need to guard against a sudden 8‑trillion‑yen dump, and their willingness to cover positions is increasing.

However, some investors remain skeptical, noting that the rule‑based intervention framework from the Trump era had weakened in enforceability; if the yen were to slip past 165, it is unclear whether Washington would tacitly allow Tokyo an exception or resort to verbal coordination plus U.S. Treasury actions, leaving a gray area.
In the short term, FX volatility is expected to ease, but the lack of an “intervention commitment” through 2027 could itself become a catalyst for the next wave of short‑selling leverage.

paras: 美元周四 (6 日) 走強，升至一周高點，受避險需求升溫及美國公債殖利率上揚支撐，市場同時靜待周五公布的關鍵就業數據。另一方面，日元兌美元跌破 158，為上周日本當局干預匯市以來首見。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 上漲 0.3%，報 99.94，前一交易日曾跌至七周低點。
美元這周稍早一度走弱，投資人轉向股票等風險性資產，帶動華爾街在 7 月表現平淡後強勢展開 8 月行情。
此外，市場預期荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 有望重新開放，也推動油價下跌，提振市場風險偏好。
不過，原油價格周四明顯反彈。媒體報導指出，伊朗與阿曼擬定的荷姆茲海峽重啟框架，將禁止美國船舶通行，直到相關賠償完成為止。
伊朗《法斯通訊社》(Fars) 引述國會議員 Alireza Salimi 報導，荷姆茲海峽方案初步文本目前正由當局審查。根據方案，在賠償完成前，美國、以色列及其他「敵對國家」船舶將不得通行這條重要航道。
《法斯通訊社》另引述伊朗外交部消息人士指出，依照方案，船舶將由靠近伊朗海岸的北側航道進入荷姆茲海峽，並由靠近阿曼海岸的南側航道離開。在特定期限後，兩側航道都將停止通行，改由中央航道取代，屆時將由伊朗負責入境管理，出境則由伊朗與阿曼共同管理。
若上述方案屬實，其中部分內容預料難以獲得華府接受。
美國總統川普本周稍早表示，由於和平協議談判取得進展，他已取消原定對伊朗發動的強力軍事攻擊，但也警告，若雙方無法達成協議，美國已「準備好採取行動」。自 2 月底戰爭爆發以來，美伊雙方持續在威脅、攻擊與讓步之間反覆交鋒。
非農就業報告公布在即
美元周四也受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒支撐。投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，預料將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
本周公布的勞動市場數據表現不一。美國 6 月職缺增幅低於預期，也較 5 月放緩，7 月 ADP 民間就業新增人數同樣不及市場預期，且增幅較 6 月降溫。
另一方面，美國首次申領失業金人數已連續第三周低於 20 萬人，這種情況自 1960 年代末以來相當罕見。
整體而言，數據顯示美國勞動市場仍具韌性，也支持聯準會近期將政策重心重新放回抑制通膨。同時，中東衝突導致油價波動，改變了通膨走勢，也讓聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 José Torres 表示，「我預期 7 月新增就業人數將連續第四個月放緩，估計僅增加 4 萬人。勞動市場正受到供給限制影響，勞動參與率大幅下滑、勞動力規模縮減，同時薪資壓力持續升高。」
他指出，「即使失業率維持偏低，只要整體新增就業數據疲弱，就足以帶動美國公債反彈。因為一旦固定收益市場投資人開始擔心企業可能縮減人力，市場就會開始反映經濟放緩風險。」
但他也表示，「目前中東局勢仍是市場關注焦點，因此無論非農就業報告結果如何，華爾街最在意的仍是美國與伊朗之間的互動。」
日元干預後首跌破 158
除了美元之外，匯市另一大焦點仍是日元。
美元兌日元上漲 0.4%，至 158.39，為近期日本當局大規模干預匯市以來，首次重新站上 158。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 這周稍早證實，美國已與日本聯手進場買進日元，這是 2011 年以來兩國首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首次直接出手。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助日本，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能衝擊整個亞洲金融市場。
在此次干預前，日元一度跌至 1 美元兌 164 日元，創 40 年新低。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Thursday (the 6th), reaching a one‑week high, supported by rising hedge demand and higher U.S. Treasury yields, while markets also awaited Friday's key employment data. Meanwhile, the yen fell below 158 per dollar, the first time since Japanese authorities intervened in the market last week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies rose 0.3% to 99.94, after having slipped to a seven‑week low the previous session.
The dollar had briefly weakened earlier this week as investors shifted toward equities and other risk assets, helping Wall Street launch a strong August rally after a flat July performance.
In addition, market expectations that the Strait of Hormuz may reopen helped push oil prices lower and boosted risk appetite.

However, oil prices rebounded sharply on Thursday. Media reports said that a framework for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, drafted by Iran and Oman, would bar U.S. vessels until related compensation is settled.

Iran’s Fars news agency, citing MP Alireza Salimi, reported that a preliminary text of the Hormuz plan is currently under review by authorities. Under the proposal, U.S., Israeli and other “hostile” ships would be prohibited from using the vital waterway until compensation is paid.

Fars also quoted an Iranian foreign‑ministry source saying that, according to the plan, vessels would enter the strait via the northern channel close to Iran’s coast and exit through the southern channel near Oman. After a set period, both side channels would close and be replaced by a central channel, with Iran handling inbound traffic and Iran and Oman jointly managing outbound traffic.
If the proposal is real, parts of it are expected to be difficult for Washington to accept.

U.S. President Trump said earlier this week that, because peace‑talk progress had been made, he had cancelled the planned strong military strike on Iran, but warned that the United States is “ready to act” if a deal cannot be reached. Since the war erupted at the end of February, the U.S. and Iran have repeatedly swung between threats, attacks and concessions.
Non‑farm payroll report imminent

The dollar on Thursday was also supported by market unease over the monetary‑policy outlook. Investors sold U.S. Treasuries, pushing yields higher. Attention shifted to Friday’s July non‑farm payroll report, expected to be a key gauge of the Fed’s rate trajectory.

Labor‑market data released this week were mixed. U.S. June job openings rose less than expected and slowed from May, and July ADP private‑sector employment added fewer jobs than forecast, with growth cooling versus June.
Conversely, first‑time unemployment claims in the United States fell below 200,000 for the third consecutive week, a rarity not seen since the late 1960s.

Overall, the data show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient, supporting the Fed’s recent shift back to focusing on inflation control. At the same time, Middle‑East conflict‑driven oil‑price swings have altered inflation trends and created policy‑direction splits among Fed officials.

Interactive Brokers senior economist José Torres said, “I expect July’s job additions to slow for the fourth straight month, estimating only 40,000 new jobs. The labor market is being constrained by supply‑side factors, with a sharp drop in labor‑force participation, a shrinking workforce and rising wage pressure.”

He added, “Even with a still‑low unemployment rate, weak overall job growth is enough to trigger a rebound in U.S. Treasuries, because once fixed‑income investors start fearing companies may cut staff, the market will price in slowdown risk.”
He also noted, “The Middle‑East situation remains the market’s focus, so regardless of the payroll outcome, Wall Street’s biggest concern is the interaction between the United States and Iran.”
Yen falls below 158 after intervention
Beyond the dollar, the yen remains a major market focus.
The dollar‑yen pair rose 0.4% to 158.39, the first time since Japanese authorities launched a large‑scale intervention that the rate has climbed back above 158.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this week that the United States has teamed up with Japan to buy yen, marking the first joint intervention since 2011 and the first direct U.S. action since 1998.
Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the U.S. is helping Japan because a continuously weakening yen could damage the broader Asian financial system.
Before the intervention, the yen had slipped to ¥164 per dollar, a 40‑year low.
RSM US economist Joseph Brusuelas said, “Don’t get it wrong—after the intervention Japan must enact real policy changes, meaning the policy rate needs to be raised to justify the money spent.”

Weaker economic data keeps the dollar under pressure
U.S. economic data remained a market focus. According to ADP, private‑sector job additions in July were 44,000, well below the 68,000 forecast and down from June’s 95,000.
The figure continued the cooling trend seen in the June job‑openings data released on Tuesday and provides a reference point for Friday’s July non‑farm payroll report.
Despite weaker labor‑market numbers this week, the overall employment picture remains resilient, supporting the Fed’s recent shift of policy emphasis back to inflation control.
The Middle‑East conflict has rattled oil prices, disrupted inflation trends and created divergence among Fed officials on the future direction of monetary policy.

In addition, the Institute for Supply Management reported that July’s services‑sector PMI rose to 54.1 from June’s 54, still shy of the 54.5 market expectation. The services‑price index, which measures changes in input costs for service firms, climbed further from June and has been above 70 in four of the past five months, indicating persistent cost pressure.
Markets anticipate that a Hormuz Strait agreement is close to being reached
Regarding the Middle‑East situation, several U.S. officials including President Trump have said that a crucial agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is nearing completion.
Trump told the media on Tuesday evening, “Things are moving very smoothly. I think we’ll know the result within 48 hours.”

He added, “We’ve made great progress. They called me and said, ‘Please, let’s talk.’ They want to start a dialogue. Interestingly, they never bring this up… I think reaching an agreement would be a very wise move for them. We’ll see.”

Iran’s foreign ministry said negotiations between Tehran and Oman on the Hormuz Strait issue are ongoing. Spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said that as long as “certain third parties” do not interfere, the joint statement is now in its final review and drafting stage.
